title: Module 3: Lab Analysis Basics
content:
Module 3: Lab Analysis Basics (8 contact hours)
Pre-requisites: Module 2 complete.
Minimum participant age: 16 (with parental consent).
Equipment: pH meter, conductivity probe, turbidimeter, DO probe, nitrate test strips.
Insurance: covered under DACES general lab policy.

title: Citizen Water-Quality Monitoring Certification - Consent Form (EN)
content:
Citizen Water-Quality Monitoring Certification - Consent Form (EN)
1. Purpose: training in environmental sampling.
2. Time commitment: 36 contact hours over 6 weeks.
3. Risks: outdoor exposure, low-volume reagent handling.
4. Benefits: certification, contribution to county data.
5. PARTICIPANT RIGHTS: You may withdraw at any time without penalty. Your data will be anonymized in any public reporting. You may request copies of your own data at any time.
6. Contact: ian.salazar@voissync.ai

content:
